title: Stability Analysis of Generalized Multi-Source Weber Problems
summary: This paper presents a stability analysis of the generalized multi-source Weber problems under the influence of data perturbation within the framework of the Minkowski function. First, we establish explicit Lipschitz constants for the objective functions and optimal value functions. Then, we prove several properties of the global optimal solution sets. Furthermore, we provide sufficient conditions for the upper semicontinuity of global solution mappings and the inner semicontinuity of local solution mappings.
